description: This file is a shell script that orchestrates the setup, build, testing, and coverage analysis of multiple components within a software project. It manages cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring builds with CMake, running unit tests with and without Valgrind, and generating coverage reports. It also handles dependency installation and environment setup.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages prefixed with '==>' for logging steps.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a command in the system's PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the script is running as root.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if 'apt-get' can run, i.e., if the script has sufficient privileges or sudo is available.

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs 'apt-get' with non-interactive options to install packages.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Executes a command, captures non-zero exit codes, and logs warnings without failing the script.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive git operations.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref (tag, branch, remote) in a repository, fetching as needed.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if missing, then checks out a specified ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory idempotently, detecting if already applied.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project using Ninja if available, with extra arguments.
